The target video uses a live-action short-drama style with cinematic still-frame quality, realist portraiture, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, and a desaturated neutral grey palette.
Night; the atmosphere, setting and image texture follow the scene reference image, lit by harsh temporary floodlights raking down from the second-floor balcony ring against cold white work lamps on tripods at floor level.
Every shot is framed inside <Subject 1>. <Subject 1> alone controls the location, its surfaces, its light direction and its colour; the character references control identity, body and costume only, and never the setting.
[Shot 1] Close shot, low angle, slight handheld shake. <Subject 3> stands inside the archway of <Subject 1> at the centre of frame, two men with iron bars planted in front of the body; the face is flooded red, one arm whips forward, and the voice tears out at full volume, cracking on the second half. <Subject 3> (S2), in a mid-low male voice, cultured and viperous, kept low and level with a chill beneath it, now ripped wide open into a roar, screams, <d>[Chinese] 慌什么！她就一个人，二十个人一起上！谁砍翻她，老子当场转一个亿！！</d> The arm stays frozen in the air, the fingers trembling.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.500, wide shot, eye level, the camera whips with large amplitude at fast speed. <Subject 2> stands in front of the Roman column in <Subject 1> just right of centre, not moving a step, while twenty men with iron bars surge in from the staircase mouth, the fireplace side and the rear steps, bars and steel pipes swinging into a blurred lattice. The camera swings hard across the incoming crowd as leather soles grind broken marble.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.500, close shot, eye level, small fast push in. <Subject 2> stands in front of the column in <Subject 1> at the centre of frame as the lens drives in on the face: one hand sweeps the shawl back over the shoulder, the chin comes up, and the order snaps out. <Subject 2> (S1), in a high-pitched female voice, bright and honeyed, the delivery hard and clipped, shouts, <d>[Chinese] 给本姑奶奶大清扫——！</d> The body then turns half away and the skirt hem whips out in an arc.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, medium shot, high angle, tracking with small amplitude at fast speed. Looking down at the centre of <Subject 1>: <Subject 2> stands at one end of the long solid-wood bench with the weight sunk low, the right toe scooping up from underneath, and the whole hundred-jin bench flips up off the floor; both hands shoot out, lock onto the two bench legs, and the shoulders press down to level it.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.000, medium shot, eye level, the camera whips with large amplitude at fast speed. <Subject 2> braces at the centre of <Subject 1> on the left of frame with the bench held across the body, then drives the hips round and swings the whole bench flat; the first four men have only just lifted a foot when the bench face meets their chests and all four are shoved off the ground by the same force.
[Shot 6] At 00:15.000, wide shot, high angle, the camera whips with large amplitude at fast speed. Looking down at the wall side of <Subject 1>: the four men sail through the air and pile into the display shelf, the whole shelf pitches forward, the blue-and-white porcelain and the wood carvings on it burst apart, and shards wash across the floor; the four stay down in the wreckage.

overall_soundscape:
A vast hollow hall tone continues, with wind in the broken windows. Twenty pairs of boots stampede across cracked marble, iron bars and steel pipes ring against each other, a bench leg cracks down on the stone, and the display shelf goes over in a long splintering crash with porcelain exploding across the floor. Men gasp and grunt under the impact, and no other character may add dialogue, laughter, or narration.
